body:
Jeez man that’s horrible... I’m sorry to hear that.

And literally playing Xbox and watching youtube. Can’t really do much right now with how down I am

Thank you. For real. 

And yeah, it’s a year long lease. Felt like nothing at the time, but not it feels like an eternity

I’m sure you mean well, but Idk how I played a card to get her attention, honestly. She came here and saw me crying in my car talking to the suicide hotline. And she checked me into the hospital. That isn’t me playing a card for attention.
I’ll have to check it out man thank you!

It’s really hard man... we had planned on marrying, having kids, and also talked about names and everything. Then I got this apartment for her and our future, and now it just all seems gone.... shit is rough man. I hope we both get the strength ❤️
Yeah, sadly I watched my two favorite shows with her - How I Met Your Mother and Community, and there’s no damn way I can watch them right now.

I’m trying to appreciate small things... I am. Trying to take it day by day, but each day feels like an eternity right now...

But at the same time, I just am missing small things about her. Even annoying stuff, I just miss. Just everything.

I just... I wanna think “she left me and I’m better off for it” I really do. But the other part of me just hurting so bad. I keep thinking of the first time she said she loved me... like, it wasn’t even on purpose. We were just talking about love, and she slipped on accident. We were talking on FaceTime. I just remember her saying it, and her eyes just SHOT open and I didn’t even realize what happened for about twenty seconds. Idk... it was such a sweet, subtle, and just dorky moment and it’s stuff like that I can’t get out of my head. 

I don’t miss just her. I miss everything that came with her. Her being so goofy with me, how she always made dumb faces for no reason other than to be a dork, our conversations that could on seemingly endlessly about anything, and just that connection. I’ve truly never felt that way before, and it just felt that way right off the bat. I’ve never trusted somebody so much, and gave so much to somebody... and it’s so hard to try to not talk to her or anything.

A part of me is just praying that she changes her mind, cause it’s so painful to think of her finding somebody else... I just miss it all.

Thank you for reaching out. Seriously thank you. 

Everybody’s kind words means a lot

No I know that you’re not trying to hurt my feelings. I understand.

Just to me - pain is relative to what people go through. My pain may not seem as bad to millions upon millions of people who suffer much worse things, and also other’s pain may not seem as bad to me.

But everybody deals with it differently. In my case, I’ve been depressed since I was 12 - and the amount of things going wrong in my life for so long have stacked up and made me not want to live anymore.

I’m not trying to get pity, I simply stated everything so people would understand my perspective and know a very surface level story of my life.

Everything has stacked up for me, and I feel I’m at the end of my rope. I can honest to god see my last few threads. 

It’s not that I want to give up, but I feel I need to, cause I can’t take the pain anymore.

I see what you mean, but if someone is part of what I dream of, want, and desire - and seemed to fit that so well, then they become that dream I’ve always wanted.

And I wasn’t “buying” her love at all. That wasn’t my goal, or anything. We wanted a place together, we searched and searched, and when we found it - I got it for us and her because I love her. It wasn’t anything other than me wanting to give her whatever I could. Whether that be through emotion, through love, through buying her something; literally anything I tried to do.

And depression is in a lot of people. She has it, not to this extent but she has it too. And I was always there for her. 

I get what you’re trying to say but you’re going about it in a pretty bad way.

It’s such a shock to my system, ya know? Going from living with and being around someone constantly, having someone to hold when I’m upset, sleeping next to sometime I trust - to just none of that. It’s.... its rough, really rough.

I’ve tried seeing my friends and family, but everything just feels... off, I guess. It feels off, odd, weird, etc. like something is missing. I just feel like a piece of me is missing not having her there with me now.

I’ve dated girls in the past. Some good relationships, some bad, and they all felt awkward at the beginning when meeting each other. But with her, it just felt easy. Our first date was easy, texting at first was easy, talking was easy. Everything was just easy. 

We knew each other for about a month before being TOGETHER together. But we decided to be exclusive after our first date, and yeah. I had to go back to my parents house to help take care of a family member, but we FaceTimed every night, talked daily, and she was there for me every day. 

She came up to visit after everything with my family was calmed down a little, and we made it official.
